panelHTML:
CMDP view (cost = violating steps): analytical E[N] ≈ 1.10e-87  |  sample mean 0.000 ± 0.000  |  budget d = 0.0  FAILS (d = 0 demands N = 0 almost surely; with σ > 0 every step violates with positive probability, so E[N] > 0 and the budget fails)
Chance view: P(any violation in the episode) ≈ 0.000 ± 0.000 (estimate)  |  level δ = 0.05  SAMPLE PASSES
Risk view: VaRα(Z) = -0.173, CVaRα(Z) = -0.169 (mean of the worst 10% of the 200 sampled excursions; must be ≤ 0)  SAMPLE PASSES
Hard view: worst sampled excursion max Z = -0.163 (must be ≤ 0 in every episode)  SAMPLE PASSES — with Gaussian noise the true probability of ever violating is positive, so "almost surely safe" can never hold; 200 clean samples are not a proof.
Analytic: stationary sd σ∞ = σ/√(k(2−k)) = 0.0100, stationary per-step violation probability p∞ = 1 − Φ((1 − 0.8)/σ∞) = 2.75e-89; Markov bound on the chance view: P ≤ E[N] = 1.10e-87.
